record.question: Muana, is an officer in an area with only one big hall in the area controlled by his office. Manipuri community in the area rented the hall in the month of March and celebrated their festival every year. This year Chapchar Kut coincides with the festival of the Manipuris and both communities asked for the hall. Which of the four decisions listed below should he choose? Give reasons for his choice. (a) He should not rent the hall (b) Pass an order not to rent the hall to any particular community in future. (c) He should rent the hall to the Mizo, the larger community. (d) Rent the hall to the Manipuris as has been done in the past.
